elements.label: Table 1.1
elements.title: Risks from steam boilers varied widely across countries in the late 1800s because of very different approaches to safety
elements.content:
Per 10,000 steam boilers, 1882–92
COUNTRY | NUMBER OF EXPLOSIONS | NUMBER OF PEOPLE KILLED
United Statesa | 20 | 29
United Kingdom | 4.9 | 2.4
France | 4.8 | 4.7
Germany | 2.2 | 1.4
Sources: Crum 1910, 17–18; Hunter 1985; MTPTC 1988; Thurston 1907, 717.
a. The widespread use of steam boilers in remote sawmills, employing low-quality machinery with minimal oversight regarding safety, contributed to the greater frequency of explosions of steam boilers in the United States.
